record.bible_text: Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> ye this, O priests<WH03548>; and hearken<WH07181><WTH8685>, ye house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>; and give ye ear<WH0238><WTH8685>, O house<WH01004> of the king<WH04428>; for judgment<WH04941> <FI>is<Fi> toward you, because ye have been a snare<WH06341> on Mizpah<WH04709>, and a net<WH07568> spread<WH06566><WTH8803> upon Tabor<WH08396>.

And the revolters<WH07846> are profound<WH06009><WTH8689> to make slaughter<WH07819><WTH8800>, though I <FI>have been<Fi> a rebuker<WH04148> of them all. <RF>though: or, and<Rf> <RF>a rebuker: Heb. a correction<Rf>

I know<WH03045><WTH8804> Ephraim<WH0669>, and Israel<WH03478> is not hid<WH03582><WTH8738> from me: for now, O Ephraim<WH0669>, thou committest whoredom<WH02181><WTH8689>, <FI>and<Fi> Israel<WH03478> is defiled<WH02930><WTH8738>.

They will not frame<WH05414><WTH8799> their doings<WH04611> to turn<WH07725><WTH8800> unto their God<WH0430>: for the spirit<WH07307> of whoredoms<WH02183> <FI>is<Fi> in the midst<WH07130> of them, and they have not known<WH03045><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068>. <RF>They will...: or, Their doings will not suffer them<Rf> <RF>frame: Heb. give<Rf>

And the pride<WH01347> of Israel<WH03478> doth testify<WH06030><WTH8804> to his face<WH06440>: therefore shall Israel<WH03478> and Ephraim<WH0669> fall<WH03782><WTH8735> in their iniquity<WH05771>; Judah<WH03063> also shall fall<WH03782><WTH8804> with them.

They shall go<WH03212><WTH8799> with their flocks<WH06629> and with their herds<WH01241> to seek<WH01245><WTH8763> the LORD<WH03068>; but they shall not find<WH04672><WTH8799> <FI>him<Fi> ; he hath withdrawn<WH02502><WTH8804> himself from them.

They have dealt treacherously<WH0898><WTH8804> against the LORD<WH03068>: for they have begotten<WH03205><WTH8804> strange<WH02114><WTH8801> children<WH01121>: now shall a month<WH02320> devour<WH0398><WTH8799> them with their portions<WH02506>.<CM>

Blow<WH08628><WTH8798> ye the cornet<WH07782> in Gibeah<WH01390>, <FI>and<Fi> the trumpet<WH02689> in Ramah<WH07414>: cry aloud<WH07321><WTH8685> <FI>at<Fi> Bethaven<WH01007>, after<WH0310> thee, O Benjamin<WH01144>.

Ephraim<WH0669> shall be desolate<WH08047> in the day<WH03117> of rebuke<WH08433>: among the tribes<WH07626> of Israel<WH03478> have I made known<WH03045><WTH8689> that which shall surely be<WH0539><WTH8737>.

The princes<WH08269> of Judah<WH03063> were like them that remove<WH05253><WTH8688> the bound<WH01366>: <FI>therefore<Fi> I will pour out<WH08210><WTH8799> my wrath<WH05678> upon them like water<WH04325>.

Ephraim<WH0669> <FI>is<Fi> oppressed<WH06231><WTH8803> <FI>and<Fi> broken<WH07533><WTH8803> in judgment<WH04941>, because he willingly<WH02974><WTH8689> walked<WH01980><WTH8804> after<WH0310> the commandment<WH06673>.
Therefore <FI>will<Fi> I <FI>be<Fi> unto Ephraim<WH0669> as a moth<WH06211>, and to the house<WH01004> of Judah<WH03063> as rottenness<WH07538>. <RF>rottenness: or, a worm<Rf>

When Ephraim<WH0669> saw<WH07200><WTH8799> his sickness<WH02483>, and Judah<WH03063> <FI>saw<Fi> his wound<WH04205>, then went<WH03212><WTH8799> Ephraim<WH0669> to the Assyrian<WH0804>, and sent<WH07971><WTH8799> to king<WH04428> Jareb<WH03377><WTH8677><WH07378><WTH8799>: yet could<WH03201><WTH8799> he not heal<WH07495><WTH8800> you, nor cure<WH01455><WTH8799> you of your wound<WH04205>. <RF>king Jareb: or, the king of Jareb: or, the king that should plead<Rf>

For I <FI>will be<Fi> unto Ephraim<WH0669> as a lion<WH07826>, and as a young lion<WH03715> to the house<WH01004> of Judah<WH03063>: I, <FI>even<Fi> I, will tear<WH02963><WTH8799> and go away<WH03212><WTH8799>; I will take away<WH05375><WTH8799>, and none shall rescue<WH05337><WTH8688> <FI>him<Fi> .

I will go<WH03212><WTH8799> <FI>and<Fi> return<WH07725><WTH8799> to my place<WH04725>, till they acknowledge their offence<WH0816><WTH8799>, and seek<WH01245><WTH8765> my face<WH06440>: in their affliction<WH06862> they will seek me early<WH07836><WTH8762>. <RF>acknowledge...: Heb. be guilty<Rf><CM>
